title: China’s Top Spy Agency Recruited Woman Who Targeted Jensen Huang
summary: U.S. intelligence concluded that Alice Huang, a Chinese business executive who developed a close relationship with Nvidia’s leader, was an asset of Beijing’s Ministry of State Security.
